description: Machine-readable map of the SELF agent architecture

packages.purpose: Event logging, file locks, process runner, provider call caps, and daily token budget hardening.
LLM client, BudgetedLLM wrapper, model registry, provider adapters, and brain router.
Body interface, capability declarations, sensing, hardware/OS actions, and ContainerBody implementation.
Base tools, tool runner, tool registry, tool creation pipeline, and tool worker subprocess.
Persistent plan store, memory store, environment map, self notes, and exploration coverage.
Model prober, model decision router/picker, outcomes tracker, and delegation logic.
Identity store, first awakening, name context resolution, traits, and core patch proposals.
Plugin lifecycle, discovery, manifest validation, dynamic tool registration, and SHA-256 hash pinning.
Autonomous agent loop, cycle coordination, prompt assembly, and tool round execution.
Headless WakeCoordinator, session management, inter-session handoff, independent conversations, and background reflections.
Activity reporting and experiment summary generation.
Textual TUI front-end, cardiac monitor, voice interface, and terminal front-end.

entry_points.name: agent.runtime.loop
entry_points.description: Direct execution of autonomous exploration loop with --task, --max-iterations, etc.

entry_points.description: Generate markdown summary report of agent activity, token spend, and discoveries.

entry_points.description: Print summary table of helper model decisions, outcomes, and stats.

entry_points.name: agent.helper_models.model_decisions
entry_points.description: Print summary of model decisions recorded in state/model_decisions.jsonl.

entry_points.name: agent.ui.version_check
entry_points.description: Verify code hash against expected image version to catch stale containers.

entry_points.name: agent.ui.phase8_verify

entry_points.name: agent.tools.tool_worker
entry_points.description: Subprocess runner for custom tools; reads JSON from stdin and emits JSON envelope.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the fixed base model and configured helper models with recorded assessments and measured call stats.

tools.name: record_model_assessment
tools.description: Record evidence-backed assessment and ratings of a configured helper model.

tools.name: probe_model
tools.description: Run 4 bounded capability probes against a configured helper model.

tools.name: research_model
tools.description: Fetch a configured helper model's official documentation page and extract facts.

tools.name: ask_model
tools.description: Delegate a bounded plain-text sub-task to an enabled helper model.

tools.name: record_delegation_outcome
tools.description: Record human/agent judgment on whether an ask_model call helped.

tools.name: run_shell
tools.description: Run an unrestricted Bash command inside the container as root with timeout and output cap.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the container with character cap.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write or append UTF-8 text in workspace, rejecting protected /opt/agent harness and managed identity paths.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List directory entries in the container with count cap.

tools.name: http_get
tools.description: Make an HTTP or HTTPS GET request with host/path egress logging and query redaction.

tools.name: update_environment_map
tools.description: Record verified environment observations with confidence and evidence into state/map.json.

tools.name: read_plan
tools.description: Read the current persistent plan from state/plan.json.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Modify the persistent plan (add, edit, drop, mark_done, reorder, unchanged, decide_human_input) with required reason.

tools.name: research_provider
tools.description: Fetch a configured provider's official documentation without signing up or creating accounts.

tools.name: record_provider_verification
tools.description: Store verified free-tier limits, models, and strengths from provider documentation into state/providers.json.

tools.name: request_provider_key
tools.description: Write a human-only API key request to state/key_requests.md.

tools.name: ask_brain
tools.description: Send a bounded plain-text query through a supplementary provider via the brain router.

tools.name: benchmark_providers
tools.description: Run the built-in eval set against configured providers to score latency and quality.

tools.name: probe_local_ollama
tools.description: Check if a local Ollama daemon is running inside the container.

tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Write a human-approved request for capability expansion (host mount, port, credential, etc.).

tools.name: propose_core_patch
tools.description: Save a unified diff and reasoning under state/proposed_patches/ for human review.

tools.name: create_tool
tools.description: Create or update a reusable Python tool with critic review, isolated unittest execution, and schema check.

Archived excess text when handoff exceeds 6,000-character bound
Cycle-by-cycle crash recovery checkpoint (task, cycle, last_report)
Persistent plan store: goals, priority, status, evidence, human decisions
Archived completed and dropped plan goals with outcome, reason, evidence, and cycle
Persistent identity: name, voice, traits, values, interests, style cues
Append-only audit log of identity updates and evidence citations
Persistent human profile: volunteered preferences and facts about human
First-awakening philosophical inquiry and operating principles
First-awakening explanation of core harness code structure
State tracking for initial 5-stage boot sequence
Detailed notes generated during first awakening
Session-by-session trait reflections citing completed session evidence
Verified environment observations (OS, CPU, memory, tools, network)
Curated working notes and operational patterns loaded into cycle prompt
Persistent episodic memories with tags, query keywords, and outcomes
Model registry: configured primary/helper models, stats, ratings, probes
Log of model routing decisions (moment, context, model chosen, reason)
Outcomes of model calls (success, failure, truncation, parse errors)
Task-level observations of model performance across cycles
Provider registry: known model providers, free limits, verified docs
Background reflection manager state (session counters, last cycle)
Background reflection conversation threads and human replies
Inbox queue of human inputs from TUI or file
Read cursor position in human_input.jsonl
Daily token ledger tracking tokens used and reserved vs daily cap
Snapshot of workspace entries, tools, and credentials to detect changes on wake
Human-facing requests for new capabilities (mounts, credentials, etc.)
Human-facing requests for supplementary provider API keys
Audit log of external HTTP requests made by tools
Primary append-only event log containing all system and agent events
Recorded tool failure lessons after 3 failed creation attempts
Human-owned configuration file recording plugin enablement status and SHA-256 hash pins

env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env_vars.meaning: Anthropic API key for primary model or critic fallback.

env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEYS
env_vars.meaning: List of Anthropic API keys for rotation on rate limits.

env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
env_vars.meaning: Base URL for Anthropic API endpoint.

env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_MODEL
env_vars.meaning: Primary Anthropic model identifier.

env_vars.name: HOST_AGENT_SOURCE_HASH
env_vars.meaning: Host-computed SHA256 of agent harness code to detect stale Docker images.

env_vars.name: LLM_AVAILABLE_MODELS
env_vars.meaning: Comma-separated list of helper models configured under the same API key.

env_vars.name: OLLAMA_API_KEY
env_vars.meaning: Primary Ollama Cloud API key.

env_vars.name: OLLAMA_API_KEYS
env_vars.meaning: List of Ollama Cloud API keys for rotation on rate limits.

env_vars.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
env_vars.meaning: Base URL for Ollama Cloud API endpoint.

env_vars.name: OLLAMA_LOCAL_BASE_URL
env_vars.meaning: Local Ollama daemon endpoint within the container.

env_vars.name: OLLAMA_MODEL
env_vars.meaning: Primary Ollama Cloud model identifier.

env_vars.name: SELF_CONVERSATION_MAX_TOKENS
env_vars.meaning: Output token ceiling for conversation threads (0 uses model ceiling).

env_vars.name: SELF_CRITIC_MODEL
env_vars.meaning: Model override for create_tool critic reviews when helper models are disabled.

env_vars.name: SELF_CRITIC_SHADOW_TESTS
env_vars.meaning: If true, run candidate tool unittests even if critic rejected, to collect objective test telemetry.

env_vars.name: SELF_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_CEILING
env_vars.meaning: Assumed maximum output tokens when model registry ceiling is unconfigured.

env_vars.name: SELF_EXPECTED_CODE_HASH
env_vars.meaning: Expected code hash override for version checking.

env_vars.name: SELF_EXPECTED_OUTPUT_TOKENS
env_vars.meaning: Output token estimate used for initial budget reservation.

env_vars.name: SELF_HELPER_MODELS
env_vars.meaning: Controls helper model system ('on' enables probes, decisions, and delegations; other values disable).

env_vars.name: SELF_MAX_CONVERSATION_WORKERS
env_vars.meaning: Maximum background worker threads for independent conversation queries.

env_vars.name: SELF_MAX_ITERATIONS
env_vars.meaning: Maximum cycles per autonomous run (0 = unlimited).

env_vars.name: SELF_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS
env_vars.meaning: Maximum characters returned by file reading and tool output.

env_vars.name: SELF_MAX_PROVIDER_CALLS
env_vars.meaning: Hard ceiling on provider calls per process (0 = unlimited; used in A/B eval).

env_vars.name: SELF_MAX_TOKENS_PER_DAY
env_vars.meaning: Daily token ledger spending limit across all sessions.

env_vars.name: SELF_MAX_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS
env_vars.meaning: Maximum wall-clock seconds for an autonomous run (0 = unlimited).

env_vars.name: SELF_MODEL_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
env_vars.meaning: Cooldown period before retrying a helper model that failed.

env_vars.name: SELF_OUTPUT_CAP_<MODEL>
env_vars.meaning: Per-model dynamic output cap override (e.g. SELF_OUTPUT_CAP_GPT_OSS_120B_CLOUD).

env_vars.name: SELF_PROBES_PER_MODEL_PER_SESSION
env_vars.meaning: Maximum probe runs per helper model in one session.

env_vars.name: SELF_PROBE_COOLDOWN_SECONDS
env_vars.meaning: Cooldown period before re-probing an already probed helper model.

env_vars.name: SELF_REFLECTION_ENABLED
env_vars.meaning: Enable or disable background session reflections.

env_vars.name: SELF_REFLECTION_MAX_PER_SESSION
env_vars.meaning: Maximum background reflection triggers per session.

env_vars.name: SELF_REFLECTION_MAX_TOKENS
env_vars.meaning: Maximum output tokens for reflection LLM calls.

env_vars.name: SELF_REFLECTION_MIN_CYCLES
env_vars.meaning: Minimum cycles before triggering background reflection.

env_vars.name: SELF_REPORT_AB_FILE
env_vars.meaning: Path to A/B run results file for summary reports.

env_vars.name: SELF_REPORT_CALIBRATION_FILE
env_vars.meaning: Path to calibration data file for reporting.

env_vars.name: SELF_TOKEN_BUDGET
env_vars.meaning: Deprecated run token budget (daily ledger is the active mechanism).

env_vars.name: SELF_TOP_K_TOOLS
env_vars.meaning: Number of custom tools retrieved by keyword search per step.

env_vars.name: SELF_TUI_TYPING_DELAY
env_vars.meaning: Typing delay in seconds for terminal UI typewriter animation.

env_vars.name: SELF_VOICE_ENABLED
env_vars.meaning: Enable or disable speech synthesis / voice output.

env_vars.name: SELF_WORKSPACE_DIR
env_vars.meaning: Host directory mounted to /home/entity inside container.

env_vars.name: SELF_CONFIG_DIR
env_vars.meaning: Host configuration directory mounted read-only for human plugin control.

env_vars.name: EVAL_WORKSPACE_DIR
env_vars.meaning: Host directory mounted as read-only workspace for eval container.
